members.title: A tale of two Nvidias
members.content: We got two very different pictures of Nvidia this week, depending on whether you were focused on the company’s latest earnings report or the tech executives loudly calling for former CEO Jensen Huang’s return. On the latest episode of TechCrunch’s Equity podcast, Kirsten Korosec, Tim De Chant, and I discussed the latest news from the AI chipmaker, which reported soaring revenue and insisted that it has no plans for Huang to return.

topic_dossiers.topic_title: 腾讯元宝发布基于群聊的Agent记忆基准

members.title: 8万条群聊消息做成考卷：腾讯元宝×KCL发布首个基于群聊构建的Agent记忆基准
members.content: < img id="wx_img" src="https://www.qbitai.com/wp-content/uploads/imgs/qbitai-logo-1.png" width="400" height="400"> 2026-11-21 19:40:11 来源：量子位 腾讯元宝×伦敦国王学院NLP团队 投稿 量子位 | 公众号QbitAI 一个九人出行群，最初商定5月1日出发，后来又改为4月30日。等到有人请AI助手发布购票提醒，它很可能还按旧日期通知。 虽然“记住”了历史，却没有真正服务好这个群。 在群聊的实际场景中，往往还有更隐蔽的要求：谁想坐靠窗位置，谁对预算有要求，哪些安排只是提议，哪些已经成为共同决定。 一个AI助手要服务一群人，关键不只是找回记忆，更是判断此刻应该使用谁的哪条记忆。 针对这一问题，腾讯元宝与伦敦国王学院NLP团队联合推出GroupAssistBench。研究基于50个真实群聊、80,299条历史消息，构建2,395道评测题，检查Agent记忆能否真正从“记得住”走向“用得好”。 研究团队比较了完整上下文、检索增强和外部记忆等14组配置。其中一个有代表性的反差是：EverMemOS在L1记忆召回评测中得分为0.621，高于使用相同任务模型的完整上下文0.570；但在L2开放式服务评测中，它的得分为0.247，低于完整上下文的0.431。

members.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
members.content: In Brief Posted: 1:37 PM PST · November 21, 2026 Image Credits:Matthias Balk/picture alliance / Getty Images Signal announced Friday that it’s limiting users’ ability to take screenshots within the secure messaging app — a response to what President Meredith Whittaker described as the “existential threat” of operating systems that integrate agentic AI.

members.title: Here are the top AI agents that can live in your text messages
members.content: Rather than downloading another app, a growing number of agents can simply be texted like an ordinary person. You text it what you need, and it can remember context, connect to the apps and services you already use, and complete tasks on your behalf. That can mean scheduling an appointment, organizing a calendar, researching a trip, sending an email, making a reservation, shopping online, or reminding you about something days later.

members.title: Can Anthropic afford to put safety first?
members.content: Today, I’m talking with Hayden Field, The Verge’s senior AI reporter, about the Anthropic IPO for the third and final episode in our series about AI in real life.The AI lab behind Claude went public on the Nasdaq last Thursday. The numbers are gigantic, but not really that important for this conversation, except to say that Anthropic has become one of the most valuable companies on the planet.The real story is what happens now — and whether Anthropic can continue to thread the needle of caring about and investing in AI safety while also being a public company beholden to shareholders.

topic_dossiers.topic_title: Thinking Machines Lab发布Inkling 2 Mini模型

members.title: 27B！穆拉蒂开源“循环脑”模型：笔记本跑Agent起飞
members.content: 长期智能体同级SOTA，其他测试仅次Qwen3.8-27B。 智东西消息，今日，前OpenAI CTO米拉·穆拉蒂（Mira Murati）联合创办的AI独角兽Thinking Machines Lab（简称：TML）推出一个新混合专家模型——Inkling 2 Mini。该模型总参数达27B，激活参数达3.4B，每个token有5.4B权重激活值以应对循环，兼顾小体积、快速度和较强性能，可在笔记本电脑上运行。 穆拉蒂在社交平台X上称：“Inkling 2 Mini是一款可在笔记本上运行的循环Transformer。循环机制让模型思考更多、输出更少。在当前这个规模下，它的思考过程仍可监控；但未来未必如此。我们还将放出一款可变循环研究模型，供业界进一步研究。” ▲TML联合创始人兼CEO米拉·穆拉蒂在社交平台X上发文 Inkling 2 Mini总内存占用约20GB，可在消费级笔记本和台式AI计算机等本地设备运行。TML研究人员曾把它带到飞机上，在MacBook Pro上离线运行，并在几分钟内构建了一个可玩的飞行模拟器。

members.title: Chess.com’s next move is a new hub for classic games, from mahjong to sudoku
members.content: Chess.com is ready to go a lot bigger than chess. After launching Gambit, a gambling-free poker site, earlier this year, the company is now adding 10 more games: backgammon, checkers, go, hearts, mahjong, shogi, sudoku, solitaire, xiangqi, and a Scrabble alternative called word. They’re all part of Chess’s new Classic Games platform, which is launching its public beta on Saturday on the web and through a new app for iOS and Android.“Our cofounders have had many people come up to them and say, ‘Hey, I run a mahjong night on Wednesdays’ or ‘I go to this local bar in Chicago with like five people。

members.title: I've just made Act-or-Ask public on Hugging Face. It's a small open model (3.8B) which sits in front of a home AI agent and decides whether a request should simply be carried out, whether an adult needs to OK it first or whether it should be turned down altogether. On 60 new situations which I wrote after training it followed my household rules 99.3% of the time, whereas the same base model with all of the rules pasted into its prompt only got to 49.7% and never said DECLINE on any of the requests where it really needed to. It runs on a laptop via Ollama and the model and the benchmark are both open. I've written up how I built it (and the one test case it still gets wrong) in the article below and I'd really like to know where it's asking too much and where it draws a line that you wouldn't.

members.title: In Situ Training of Optical Neural Networks by Coding Agents
members.content: Published on Nov 18 Authors: , , , Abstract A coding agent trains an optical neural network from measurements alone by reparametrizing it with interpretable optical elements, achieving better classification and image encoding than gradient-free methods and approaching backpropagation through a calibrated model at lower cost. Optical neural networks promise fast, energy-efficient computing, but every device departs from its design and must be trained with the hardware. In situ training relies on an expert-built calibrated digital model of each device or on gradient-free trial and error.

members.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
members.content: Published on Nov 16 Authors: , , , , , , , , , Abstract Language models are trained once, frozen and deployed: improving one again takes another training run, and a prompt, a scaffold or extra computation at inference is gone once the task ends. A frontier model has been shown to edit the weights of a much smaller one. We ask whether a model can rewrite its own weights to make itself better, and find that it can, by its own reasoning, with no gradients and no training; we call this self-rewriting.

members.title: AURA: AUdio-dRiven streaming Avatar
members.content: Published on Nov 19 Authors: , , , Abstract AURA enables low-latency, causal video generation for streaming applications by utilizing a rolling KV cache and a two-stage distillation pipeline to significantly reduce the required diffusion steps. Current audio-driven video diffusion models can synthesize realistic talking-head videos but generally require dozens of diffusion denoising steps over multi-second video chunks, making them unsuitable for streaming applications such as voice assistants and virtual avatars, where low-latency and online causal generation are required properties.

members.title: Online Mistake Detection in Instruction-Conditioned Procedural Video
members.content: Published on Nov 19 Authors: , Abstract An assistant monitoring a person performing a procedure is most useful when it can detect mistakes while there is still time to recover. This requires judging actions against task instructions as the video unfolds, identifying the attempted step, locating it in time, and assessing its execution. Existing online detectors do not use the instruction text, while instruction-conditioned methods operate offline. In this paper, we study online, instruction-conditioned mistake detection in egocentric videos.

members.title: SpecWM: Turning Verification into Refinement for Streaming World Models
members.content: Published on Nov 19 Authors: , , , , , , , , , , Abstract SpecWM is a training-free inference framework for streaming video world models that verifies draft chunks using the target model's latent velocity field and applies reusable corrections via threshold-based accept/refine/reject decisions to improve visual quality, control, and speed. Recently, video world models have advanced interactive generation, with large models offering higher quality and smaller models enabling faster inference.

members.title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
members.content: Thanks, this is a sharp read, and I agree with the framing: a failure becomes a logged choice with a probability. s1a plan prints every question, the top options and their probabilities, and every run can be replayed from the stored answers. Non-enumerable arguments: paths, free text and IDs are not enumerated from the schema. They are filled from candidates the compiler extracts, plus a "not specified" option.
